audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer sides said 'Skill' on rows 1, first item and 2+ items while content win[] and the packet say Sylas level 1, Katarina at first item, Sylas at 2+ items.
audit.why: Sylas out-ranges her level 1 pre-daggers; her first item spikes roam resets; late Sylas steals Death Lotus and out-sustains.

audit.why: Spikes: even 3-5 spacing game, Sylas 6 (steals Death Lotus, 75s cd), Katarina first item roam/reset spike, Sylas late brawls. Content spikes[] covers all four.

audit.whatIsWrong: Multiple fields claimed Petricite Burst 'silences' and interrupts Death Lotus — Sylas has NO silence anywhere in his kit (packet flagged the name as suspect). Also no digit in breakdown.cooldowns, widespread misgendering, and two copy-paste-bleed bullets.
audit.why: Petricite Burst is bonus magic damage + attack speed on empowered autos, per Riot's text. The verified 6 interaction is Hijack stealing Death Lotus. Death Lotus also applies Grievous Wounds (kit antiHeal flag), which halves Kingslayer — trade before it lands.
audit.corrected: All silence claims replaced with the Hijack steal; her R's healing cut added; cooldown numbers added (Shunpo 12/11/10/9/8s, Death Lotus 75/60/45s); pronouns and bleed fixed.

edits.before: You out-range Katarina at level 1 with Petricite Burst and E poke before she has her dagger-reset combos. Punish her early last-hits, but from level 2 it becomes a spacing game around her E Shunpo, so don't stand next to daggers she can teleport to. Trade with Chain Lash and keep Petricite Burst up as a silence threat to deter her all-in.
edits.after: You out-range Katarina at level 1 with Petricite Burst and E poke before she has her dagger-reset combos. Punish her early last-hits, but from level 2 it becomes a spacing game around her E Shunpo, so don't stand next to daggers she can teleport to. Trade with Chain Lash and keep a whirl charge loaded to punish any Shunpo onto you.

edits.before: Levels 2 through 5 are skill-driven: both of you have kill pressure and it comes down to who commits cleaner around dagger placement and wave state. At 6 you tilt ahead, because Petricite Burst's silence interrupts her Death Lotus channel and Hijack can steal the ult entirely. Track her roams and ping her missing, since her reset snowball is her whole game plan.
edits.after: Levels 2 through 5 are skill-driven: both of you have kill pressure and it comes down to who commits cleaner around dagger placement and wave state. At 6 you tilt ahead, because Hijack can steal Death Lotus entirely and her 75-second ultimate becomes your all-in button. Track her roams and ping her missing, since her reset snowball is her whole game plan.

edits.before: Katarina's first item spikes her roam and reset speed, so that window favours her map pressure, and you should match her or trade objectives. In teamfights you flip it back: cancel or steal Death Lotus with your kit, and your Kingslayer sustain wins the extended brawl. Time Zhonya's or a bit of MR around her all-in to blunt her burst.
edits.after: Katarina's first item spikes her roam and reset speed, so that window favours her map pressure, and you should match her or trade objectives. In teamfights you flip it back: steal Death Lotus with Hijack and let Kingslayer win the extended brawl. Time Zhonya's or a bit of MR around her all-in — her R also cuts your healing while it channels.

notes: Fabrication removed: seven fields claimed Sylas's Petricite Burst 'silences' and interrupts Death Lotus — his kit has no silence (packet suspectNames flagged it). Replaced everywhere with the verified Hijack steal; whether Sylas's E2 pull interrupts her R channel is not answerable from the kits, so no cancel claim was written. Death Lotus applies Grievous Wounds (kit antiHeal flag) — added to 'late' and breakdown.cooldowns per missing-interactions. Kat Q Bouncing Blade carries a 'grounding' derived flag but Riot's text describes only a bouncing dagger — flag misfire, no grounding claim written. Chart: moved phases[0] to Sylas, phases[5] to Katarina (why rewritten), phases[6] to Sylas; content win[] already matched all three, so side-only per the chart rule.
